Name.jp: ハンマー・レプタイル

description.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>.
description.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
description.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>을 부여합니다.
description.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

description.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>.

description.en:
(Passive Effect)
<color=#ffd732>Upon death, grants 50 Action Points and 4 Chain Points for each remaining enemy.</color>

Increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> proportional to <color=#28d9ed>missing Health</color>.
description.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#ffd732>倒れた時、敵全体にAPを50、CPを4獲得させる。</color>

自分の<color=#28d9ed>残りHP</color>が低いほど<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>がUPする。
description.kr:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#ffd732>사망 시 적 한 명당 AP 50, CP 4 씩 회복시킵니다.</color>

자신의 <color=#28d9ed>현재 체력</color>이 낮을수록 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 증가합니다.
description.zh:
(被动效果)
<color=#ffd732>死亡时，使每个敌人的AP恢复50、CP恢复4。</color>

自身<color=#28d9ed>当前生命值</color>越低，则<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>越高。
